cohort: 19 pregnant women with epilepsy who presented at the neurology clinic of Shifa International Hospital, Islamabad from January 2009 to December 2010.
finding: The frequency of major malformations in babies born to epileptic mothers was low, but pregnancy-related complications (including IUD and caesarian section) were seen in almost one-third of the patients.
mod_finding: Higher incidence of caesarian section was observed in the epileptic mothers.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in two babies
